math_check_ensemble_exclusion.evidence: Canonical `by_asset_class_policy_clean_net` shows CRYPTO aggregate: total_pnl = -0.56pp (from ensemble) + 0.11pp (from all others) = -0.45pp. Total_trades = 79 (ensemble) + 121 (all others) = 200. Aggregate PF = (total_wins / total_losses) = (0.11 / 0.56) = 0.196 (not 0.64 as claimed). After removing ensemble: total_pnl = 0.11pp, total_trades = 121. Assuming win/loss ratio from remaining emitters: wins = 0.11pp, losses = 0pp (since all remaining have positive pnl). PF = wins/losses = undefined (division by zero). Using a conservative estimate: if we assume the remaining 121 trades have a 50% win rate and average win/loss ratio of 1.2, PF = 1.2. But canonical data shows all remaining emitters have positive pnl, so PF is infinite. The plan's claim of 1.4-1.7 is arbitrary and unsupported.
